evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

definition.workflowName: Dependabot Dependency Checker - explicitly partial native deliveries

intent.goal: Identify direct Go dependency and Playwright CLI update opportunities, assess compatibility conservatively, group genuinely safe single-step patches, separate uncertain/minor updates and skip major or breaking updates.
intent.acceptance: Exact recommended old/new versions occur in independent actual-merge/first-parent root go.mod, direct on both sides, not replaced/excluded; newer version and same semantic major. Pseudo-version advances are structural updates, not verified safe-patch classifications.

evidence.opportunity: Four expressly recommended direct root-Go-module targets from four selected implementation PRs; native pin advancement only, not complete A/B/C compatibility assessment.
filters: Retrospective fixed-reference and selected-case assessment; not complete historical repository or workflow output coverage.
Immutable actual merge/first-parent source transitions only; one opportunity is counted in one interval.
Periods without evaluated eligible cases are unknown, never zero workflow delivery.
Original strict acceptance, behavior safeguards, historical executor continuity and authoritative creation receipts remain separate.
evidence.collection: Offline replay of digest-checked original Git commits, trees and source blobs plus bounded public GitHub originals; no target code or network execution.

model.architecture: Goal-specific native interpreter over portable immutable originals; only custody and scheduling are shared.
model.recommendation: Not rated: no agreed keep bar or complete comparable history. Do not interpret selected-case missing periods as deterioration.

metrics.name: Recommended dependency targets implemented
metrics.formula: Sum independently verified native partial deliveries in evaluated retained cases within this disjoint interval; null when no eligible retained case was evaluated.

metrics.name: Corroborated shared workflow contribution
metrics.formula: The same native deliveries restricted to original recommendation and implementation-reference matches; shared contribution, not sole causation.

limitations.strictAcceptanceRule: Independent source-era release/changelog and opportunity population prove correct A/B/C classification, required grouping/individualization/skips and issue cleanup; native delivered target plus independent required compatibility tests at the accepted implementation revision.
